name: Keto Crustless Pizza Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs Italian sausage, hot or mild, casing removed
3 cups pizza blend cheese (shredded mozzarella/provolone blend)
why: Lane fit as a cheese-bound crustless casserole: no crust, dish identity is the melted 3-cup pizza-cheese-and-sauce bake over the fillings (crustless pizza), with Italian sausage and pepperoni as components. Verified from the recipe card at 436 cal / 23g protein / 7g carbs per serving over 12 servings - mid-low in the 400-650 band and well under the 35g carb ceiling, structurally low-carb (no dough/rice/potato). Bakes and weigh-and-divides cleanly; scales past 14. All mains map to the board: italian-sausage, pepperoni, pizza blend cheese -> shredded-cheese, tomato basil sauce -> pasta-sauce/pizza-sauce, bell-peppers, onions, mushrooms/portobello-mushrooms, olive-oil. CAVEAT for selector: this is cheese-bound, NOT egg-bound - if the lane wants an egg custard structure specifically, this is the wrong shape; true egg-bound bakes (ham/broccoli quiche 319, spinach-artichoke egg casserole 230, chile relleno 288-334) all fell under the 400 floor at realistic cuts. Confidence HIGH on numbers (read from recipe card), MEDIUM on lane-identity acceptance.
